keyLimits.en: 10 website pages, 70 high-resolution images, no image storage add-on, 10 client galleries.
Unlimited pages, 1,500 high-resolution images, 100GB image storage, 15 hosted video minutes, 50 client galleries.
Unlimited pages and images, 1TB image storage, 120 hosted video minutes, 250 client galleries, CRM Light, client contracts.

cautions.en: The pricing page shows a promotional annual discount (up to 50%, time-limited); regular monthly prices are the ones recorded here.

capabilities.en: Mobile-optimized portfolio website builder with award-winning templates.
Built-in client galleries with proofing, download, and password protection.
Online store for selling prints and digital products (Pro and above).
Lightroom plugin for direct publishing from Adobe Lightroom.

limitations.en: No free plan; only a 14-day trial before a paid subscription is required.
Custom code editor and custom fonts are unavailable on the entry Basic plan.
Client galleries, storage, and hosted video minutes are capped even on paid plans.

reason.en: Direct competitor: portfolio and client-gallery builder for photographers.

unknowns: No annual list price shown independent of the current promotional discount; regular annual pricing could not be confirmed beyond the monthly rate.
